⚖️ BalanceScale

A scale shows several weights on each side, and you must determine whether the left side is heavier, the right side is heavier, or they are perfectly balanced. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the weight labels on each pan carefully.
  2. Determine the total weight on the left and right sides.
  3. Click heavier/equal/lighter based on your calculation.
  4. Expressions may involve repeated variables — count carefully.
  5. Solve each puzzle to advance — wrong answers end the round.
